children: Atkore announced the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period for its merger with Prysmian expired and the definitive proxy has been mailed to shareholders.
HSR waiting period expired effective 11:59 p.m. ET on Sept. 14, 2026, clearing an antitrust procedural hurdle for the Merger.
Merger remains subject to stockholder approval and other customary closing and regulatory conditions.
Definitive proxy statement was first mailed to Atkore stockholders on or around Sept. 9, 2026 to solicit votes.
Completion risks noted include potential failure to obtain approvals, stockholder rejection, or other closing-condition failures.
